summary_probe.scope: Full synthetic CA/OR/WA benchmark only; not an approved seller roster
summary_probe.sql:
WITH activity AS (
 SELECT account_id, count(*) AS activity_count
 FROM workspace.ln_premium_silver.activities GROUP BY account_id
), paid AS (
 SELECT admission_account_id AS account_id, sum(valid_admission_quantity) AS valid_admission_tickets
 FROM workspace.ln_premium_gold.regional_sales WHERE admission_account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY admission_account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, v.state AS venue_state, t.contract_end,
 t.latest_activity_at, coalesce(x.activity_count,0) AS activity_count,
 coalesce(p.valid_admission_tickets,0) AS valid_admission_tickets
FROM workspace.ln_premium_gold.account_attention t
JOIN workspace.ln_premium_silver.accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id
JOIN workspace.ln_premium_silver.venues v ON v.venue_id=a.primary_venue_id
LEFT JOIN activity x ON x.account_id=a.account_id
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.account_id=a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id
notes: CLI elapsed includes submission, polling and retrieval; not SQL engine duration.
This is a SQL and payload measurement; no model/harness scan ran.
Paid ticket quantity uses existing regional_sales semantics; this query makes no recommendation.

pagination_probe.scope: Full synthetic CA/OR/WA, benchmark only; no seller authorization claim
pagination_probe.sql:
WITH page AS (
 SELECT a.account_id,a.account_name,v.state AS venue_state,t.contract_end,t.latest_activity_at
 FROM workspace.ln_premium_gold.account_attention t
 JOIN workspace.ln_premium_silver.accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id
 JOIN workspace.ln_premium_silver.venues v ON v.venue_id=a.primary_venue_id
 WHERE a.account_id > :after_account_id
 ORDER BY a.account_id LIMIT 50
), activity AS (
 SELECT x.account_id,count(*) AS activity_count
 FROM workspace.ln_premium_silver.activities x JOIN page p ON p.account_id=x.account_id
 GROUP BY x.account_id
), paid AS (
 SELECT r.admission_account_id AS account_id,sum(r.valid_admission_quantity) AS valid_admission_tickets
 FROM workspace.ln_premium_gold.regional_sales r JOIN page p ON p.account_id=r.admission_account_id
 GROUP BY r.admission_account_id
)
SELECT p.account_id,p.account_name,p.venue_state,p.contract_end,p.latest_activity_at,
 coalesce(a.activity_count,0) AS activity_count,coalesce(v.valid_admission_tickets,0) AS valid_admission_tickets
FROM page p LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.account_id=p.account_id LEFT JOIN paid v ON v.account_id=p.account_id
ORDER BY p.account_id
pagination_probe.note: Keyset correctness and result bytes, not a speedup or SQL bytes-scanned guarantee.
